leftEvidence.title: The Spirit rests on the shoot from Jesse

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: A shoot from Jesse receives the Spirit of wisdom, understanding, counsel, might, knowledge, and fear of the LORD.
points.right: Jesus comes from Nazareth, is baptized by John, and immediately sees the heavens torn open and the Spirit descending.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: The Spirit-equipped ruler judges beyond sight and hearing, defending the poor with righteousness.
points.right: A voice directly addresses Jesus as beloved Son and names divine pleasure.

payload.posture: Isaiah and Mark place the Spirit on a Davidic or messianic figure.

rightEvidence.title: The heavens are torn open over Jesus

payload.tension: Isaiah develops just rule; Mark narrates an event without repeating that commission.
payload.title: The resting Spirit and the descending Spirit
